newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police seize 530 kgs cocaine, arrest seven.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police seize 530 kgs cocaine, arrest seven.

text.p: Belgian police and customs have arrested seven people and seized 530 kilos (1,160 pounds) of cocaine hidden in a shipment of railway sleepers, the Belga news agency said on Monday.
The haul, with a street value of nearly $86 million, was one of the biggest ever in Belgium and was destined for the Dutch and Belgian drugs markets, the agency said.
No immediate comment was available from the Antwerp public prosecutor's office.
Belgian police had been tipped off in January that the sleepers, stored in a container which was sent to Antwerp via Rotterdam on a Venezuelan ship, might contain drugs.

Initial checks by police in Rotterdam confirmed that the sleepers contained cocaine but the cargo was allowed to go through to Antwerp to lead police to the drug traffickers. Those arrested included personnel from a Belgian transport company.
